VOLUNTEEER.reason: Verified non-Canadian artist. VOLUNTEEER is part of the New York independent music circle documented around Hess Is More and This Is Care Of. Le Poisson Rouge specifically identifies Volunteeer among New York bands whose members contributed to Hess Is More, while the matching VOLUNTEEER catalogue includes the 2014 single 'The Ocean' on This Is Care Of and later Hess Is More collaborations. This is therefore the New York-based project, not a Canadian artist.
